verdict.rationale: Mistral documents that its models can be self-hosted, labels them with licenses (e.g. Mistral Small 4 under Apache 2.0), and indexes a "Model weights" page with download links and usage guidelines. Model cards describe models such as Mistral Large 3 as open-weight, and community reports confirm Devstral runs locally. The licensing statement is muddled, though: it calls the weights Apache 2.0 for research/individual use but says commercial deployments need a separate Mistral license. Missing for 10: clear, consistent per-model license terms (commercial versus Apache 2.0); hands-on corroboration of the download-and-run workflow beyond brief community mentions.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can download the model weights under a stated license and run them myself — or the platform is honest that weights are closed

citations.quote: you can self-host our models anywhere. Open-weight models (e.g., Mistral 7B) are Apache 2.0 licensed for research/individual use

Open-weight, general-purpose, flagship multimodal and multilingual model
